statement: A constant interior sample has unbounded likelihood and no finite fit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {v b p : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hb : v < b) (hp : 0 < p) : let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0 let L := fun u : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLik (fun _ : Fin n ↦ v) b p u.1 u.2 ¬ BddAbove (L '' D) ∧ ¬ ∃ u ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D u
dossier_scope_note: Constant branch of criterion and failure. Nonconstant coercivity and characterization of all constant escapes are open.

statement: Subunit upper shape gives endpoint divergence exactly at sample contact. At upper shape at least one the likelihood attains and finite superlevels lie in compact feasible sets.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} {M p q c : ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hle : ∀ i, x i ≤ M) (heq : ∃ i, x i = M) (hp : 0 < p) (_hq : 0 < q) (hc : 0 < c) : let D := if q = 1 then Ici M else Ioi M let L := fun b ↦ logLik x b p q c let E : ℝ → EReal := fun b ↦ if M < b ∨ (b = M ∧ q = 1) then (L b : EReal) else if b = M ∧ q < 1 then ⊤ else ⊥ (∀ b, E b = ⊤ ↔ b = M ∧ q < 1) ∧ (q < 1 → Tendsto (fun t ↦ L (M / (1 - t) ^ c⁻¹)) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop ∧ ∀ {ι : Type} {l : Filter ι} {b : ι → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ j in l, b j ∈ D) → (Tendsto (L ∘ b) l atTop ↔ Tendsto b l (𝓝 M))) ∧ (1 ≤ q → (∃ b ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D b) ∧ ∀ A : ℝ, ∃ K : Set ℝ, IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ D ∧ ∀ b ∈ D, A ≤ L b → b ∈ K)
dossier_scope_note: Failure claim, including constant data and ties, on the extended endpoint convention.

statement: At held shape the finite-fit criterion compares an actual stationary point to the optimized Gompertz face, includes finite equality, and rules out constant samples.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) : let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ShapeFacesPGW.logLik x b p.1 p.2 let G := AllFreePGW.gompertzLogLik x b ∃ r ∈ Ioi 0, IsMaxOn G (Ioi 0) r ∧ ((∃ p ∈ Weibull.domain, IsMaxOn L Weibull.domain p) ↔ (∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) ∧ ∃ a > 0, ∃ c > 0, deriv (fun s ↦ L (s, c)) a = 0 ∧ deriv (fun s ↦ L (a, s)) c = 0 ∧ G r ≤ L (a, c))
dossier_scope_note: The scalar reduction and finiteness of the retained stationary list are not asserted.

statement: Fixing a lower endpoint outside the sample, a subunit upper shape gives divergence along a feasible path approaching the maximum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} {l r a b : ℝ} (hl : ∀ i, l < x i) (hr : ∀ i, x i ≤ r) (hmax : ∃ i, x i = r) (_ha : 0 < a) (_hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) : let R := fun t : ℝ ↦ l + (r - l) / (1 - t) (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ i, x i ∈ Ioo l (R t)) ∧ Tendsto R (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 r) ∧ Tendsto (fun t ↦ NonstandardBeta.logLik x l (R t) (a, b)) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
dossier_scope_note: The lower endpoint is a free choice and can be any point below the sample. All tied maxima and constant samples are allowed.

statement: Fixing an upper endpoint outside the sample, a subunit lower shape gives divergence along a feasible path approaching the minimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℝ} {l r a b : ℝ} (hl : ∀ i, l ≤ x i) (hr : ∀ i, x i < r) (hmin : ∃ i, x i = l) (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hb : 0 < b) : let L := fun t : ℝ ↦ -(-r + (r - l) / (1 - t)) (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ i, x i ∈ Ioo (L t) r) ∧ Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 l) ∧ Tendsto (fun t ↦ NonstandardBeta.logLik x (L t) r (a, b)) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
dossier_scope_note: The upper endpoint is a free choice and can be any point above the sample. All tied minima and constant samples are allowed.

statement: On nonnegative residuals, the shape-one scale collapse diverges at majority contact. At exact half contact it reaches the finite supremum and finite fits exist precisely for equal positive residuals.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (hm : ∀ i, m ≤ x i) : let k := (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ x i = m).card let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | p.1 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (m, p.2) ∈ GEV.domain x p.1} let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ GEV.logLik x p.1 (m, p.2) let P := fun s : ℝ ↦ (1, s) (∀ s > 0, P s ∈ D) ∧ (n < 2 * k → Tendsto (L ∘ P) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop ∧ ¬ BddAbove (L '' D) ∧ ¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ∧ (n = 2 * k → Tendsto (L ∘ P) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Shape2GEV.halfValue x m)) ∧ IsLUB (L '' D) (Shape2GEV.halfValue x m) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ ∃ s > 0, ∀ i, m < x i → x i - m = s))
dossier_scope_note: Held-location failure claim. The negative residual and strict sub-half cases belong to the criterion claim.
